bosnia-and-herzegovina.title: Flag of Bosnia and Herzegovina

colors.note: A medium blue echoing European Union and United Nations symbolism, evoking peace.
The triangle represents the country's three main ethnic groups — Bosniaks, Croats, and Serbs — and Bosnia's roughly triangular geographic shape.
The row of stars represents Europe; the sequence continues infinitely, implying they extend beyond the flag's edges.

desc:
- A medium-blue field with a yellow right triangle rising from the bottom edge to the top hoist corner
- Seven full five-pointed white stars and two half-stars run diagonally beside the triangle's hypotenuse
- Adopted on 4 February 1998 after the Dayton Peace Agreement ended the Bosnian War
trivia:
- The design, by Mladen Kolobaric, was imposed by UN High Representative Carlos Westendorp after parliament failed to agree
- The stars are cut off at top and bottom to suggest an infinite series, symbolising continuity
- The triangle's three points are often interpreted as the three constituent peoples as well as the country's shape
